summary: You take the School of Engineering math (MATH 19, 20, 21 and a statistics course; MATH 53, 106, 115 or CME 102 with a C or better can replace MATH 21), PSYCH 1, 15 more units of approved math and science (30 in all), a Technology in Society course and two Engineering Fundamentals, then the Design core, one Methods track, one Domain pathway (one List A class and two more from List A or B) and one capstone sequence, which is also your WIM. The Physical and AI tracks also require MATH 51 or CME 100 (CS 103 for AI), and PHYSICS 41 and ENGR 14 or CS 106A; those courses count in their School of Engineering category too. Every course must be taken for a letter grade when one is offered, and a course counts in only one category. Only one of PHYSICS 41 and 41E counts, MATH 51 and CME 100 together count for at most 8 units, ENERGY 177A and 177B count for TiS together at 3 units each, and NBIO 101 at 3 units. You check by hand the 2.0 GPA, math waivers and AP credit, the NBIO 101 application, and that your Domain courses were on the approved list the year you took them.
